'''Ellos Ripfire''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent who worked as a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] for the [[ComNet Corporation]] on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]]. He would use his job as cover in order to be around situations that might provide him valuable information. To accomplish this, Ellos would sometimes sabotage equipment so that it would break at a specific time so he would have an excuse to be present.<ref name="Game" />

At some point, Ellos learned through an information trader that an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] courier named [[Tiber Quent]] was going to be on Ord Mynock. He would be carrying technical plans for an Imperial project named [[Firestorm (plan)|''Firestorm'']]. Ellos planned to cause a blackout at the spaceport and steal the plans from Quent. Once that was done, he was going to hide them in a secret compartment of his [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="Game" />
